security.csp: default-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; script-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost

bundle.shortDescription: Pomodoro timer and habit tracker at the top of your screen
bundle.longDescription: KaizeNotch is a small pill at the top of your screen: hover it to start a pomodoro, tick off habits, and open a report of your week. Optional sharing puts a read-only copy of the report on the web.
